project_type: Laravel 13 monolith — Blade views + static CSS, no Node/Vite build
build_system: Composer 2.8.10 (Laragon on Windows). No npm/Node. Static CSS committed at public/css/app.css. Views are Blade templates referencing CDN Tailwind or the static CSS.
test_framework: PHPUnit 12.5 via `php artisan test`. Feature tests use RefreshDatabase + SQLite in-memory.
build_command: php artisan config:clear && php artisan route:list (confirms routes compile)
verification_instructions: 1. `php artisan config:clear` 2. `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed` (all tables + seeded data, credentials printed) 3. `php artisan route:list` (all routes resolve) 4. `php artisan test` (full suite green) 5. `vendor\bin\pint --test` (code style)
snapshot_or_generated_files: public/css/app.css is a committed static file, not generated. database/database.sqlite is the dev DB.
environment_constraints: imagick extension NOT installed — QR must be SVG only (no PNG). No Node/npm/Vite — views must not reference vite() or mix(). QUEUE_CONNECTION=database with no worker — notification listeners must be synchronous. SQLite — no ->after(), no column drops in migrations. Path has a space: 'c:\Users\HP\BUSINESS PERMIT_SYSTEM\app' — always quote.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md. Follow Laravel conventions. Use config('permit.*') for all tunables — never hard-code municipality, prefix, or payment values. role column excluded from User fillable. All status changes through ApplicationWorkflowService (never directly). Use 'Bansud, Oriental Mindoro' — 'Bongabong' must appear NOWHERE.
key_patterns: User model uses PHP 8 attributes (#[Fillable(...)], #[Hidden(...)]) and a casts() method — follow the same style. bootstrap/app.php is the middleware/routing config point (Laravel 13 style). config/permit.php is the single config source. The local disk root is storage/app/private (NOT symlinked to public).
directory_structure: Standard Laravel 13 structure: app/ (Models, Http/Controllers, Services, Policies, Events, Listeners, Exceptions, Contracts, Providers), bootstrap/app.php, config/, database/ (migrations, seeders, factories, database.sqlite), resources/views/, routes/web.php, public/ (index.php, css/), storage/app/private/ (uploads), tests/ (Feature, Unit), vendor/. No custom directories yet beyond .agents/tasks/.
